_doc: Mistheim's Classes (#1637): one entry per Class that WORLD.md brackets ([Watermaster], [Reeve]...), and any Class invented since. Master canon, read through src/artificer/classes.ts and checked by classes.test.ts against WORLD.md. docs/class-registry.md has the rules. A Class is a capitalised [bracketed] word in WORLD.md prose (not in code blocks), apart from the word [Classes] itself; its plural (name + s) and its listed forms (a People before the name, a gendered or irregular spelling) are the same Class, while a narrower Class built on another (Steppe Scout on Scout) is its own entry with variantOf. peoples are content/peoples-lore.json ids; widespread means held across Peoples, with peoples listing those canon names. source is `WORLD.md § heading`, or `file › label` for a Class invented outside WORLD.md, which then needs invented. invented / canonised are when a Class was made up for the game and when the owner made it canon, where known; Classes in WORLD.md before 2026-10-11 have no dates. storyEngine maps each storytelling/types.ts CharClass to the entry it stands for, or null for an engine-only class; the engine doesn't read this file.
